Job Description:

Job Title: Lead, Product Line Management
Job Code: 44234
Job Location: Salt Lake City,
Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

L3Harris Broadband Communication Sector is currently seeking a Product Manager to support RF Communications products in our portfolio. The successful candidate will develop a product strategy across the organization while working closely with program management, engineering, operations and finance. The candidate will also identify and align markets that complement our business. The candidate will be responsible for identifying the product positioning, setting pricing, fulfilling forecasts and executing product promotion. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who is able to identify and reconcile needs in products, processes and systems. Other duties as assigned.

Essential Functions:

·       The Product Manager is chiefly responsible for all aspects for their assigned products, to include: product lifecycle management, sales, strategy, development, production, and financial performance. Specific functions to be performed under limited supervision include:
·       Leads and directs work of cross-functional teams comprised of skilled professionals in production, finance, engineering and administrative disciplines
·       Interface with customers to understand Concept of Operations (CONOPS), Use Cases, overall customer requirements, and market demands to influence product(s) roadmaps
·       Provide leadership of the core product team to establish design concepts, criteria and engineering efforts for product research, development, validation, manufacturing, integration and test activities
·       Partner with the Internal Research And Development (IRAD) team to develop new features and products (new product introduction and launch)
·       Represent the voice of the customer within the plant
·       Create roadmaps, market landscapes, and competitive landscape analysis
·       Determine value-based product pricing based on market and competitive environment
·       Promote products through creation of marketing material, launch plans, and various other sales tools to support internal and external customers
·       Resolve internal performance issues arising from engineering design or operations production
·       4+ years of Product Management experience
·       2 years’ experience creating and delivering professional presentations for Executive Level Teams, Engineering Teams, Business Development Teams, and Vendor Teams – Both internal and external
·       Strong technical aptitude
·       Manage budgets for product improvements and defect resolutions
·       Mentor junior team members
·       Ability to travel up to 10%

Qualifications:

•      Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
•      Active US Secret Clearance.

Preferred Additional Skills:

•      Prior Product Management experience either in a hardware deliverable or a stand-alone software deliverable
•      Master’s Degree in Business or Engineering
•      Experience with strategy development
•      Experience in DoD industry; familiarity with Military User community is a plus

Job Title: Lead, Product Management
Job Code: 43315
Job Location: Colorado Springs CO, Palm Bay FL, Herndon VA, Rochester NY, Salt Lake City UT, or any other Major L3Harris Site
Job Schedule: 9/80
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the productization and portfolio management of our Split Radio, Enterprise Surveillance Management (ESM), and network/security solutions, driving offerings from concept through production and sustainment within the Federal Government and international markets. In this role, you will develop compelling business cases, define market requirements, build multi-year product roadmaps, and recommend investment strategies while collaborating across Sales, Engineering, Program Management, and Marketing to deliver innovative solutions aligned with customer needs and L3Harris' core competencies. You will serve as a key voice of the product both internally and externally — partnering with Marketing and Business Development on thought leadership, collateral, and customer-facing events, while communicating complex technical concepts with executive-level clarity across all levels of the organization.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape and lead Mission Networks' next chapter — building on the proven strengths of our program execution culture to establish a scalable, product-driven growth engine that broadens our portfolio and deepens our impact across global markets.
Essential Functions:
- Own the productization of the Split Radio, Enterprise Surveillance Management (ESM) capability, and network/security solutions, driving offerings from concept through production and sustainment
- Develop and complete business cases for product offerings; provide strategic direction and oversight aligned with L3Harris' core competencies
- Define market requirements and translate them into product description documents for execution teams
- Develop and maintain multi-generational product roadmaps, prioritize feature definitions, and release timing in alignment with customer needs and market trends
- Partner with engineering teams to develop multi-generational technology plans for the products in the portfolio
- Based on the multi-generational product and technology roadmaps, recommend investment plans to support capability enhancements and portfolio growth
- Establish pricing strategy, catalog part number deployment, and customer pipeline targets to support revenue generation for approved business cases
- Evaluate make-versus-buy alternatives to optimize portfolio offerings in alignment with core competencies
- Collaborate with Sales & Business Development, Program Management, Marketing, and Engineering to deliver integrated product solutions
- Partner with Marketing to develop messaging, collateral, thought leadership content, and customer-facing event strategies
- Develop sales tools and training materials; support trade shows, customer demonstrations, and sales presentations to expand the customer pipeline
- Partner with pricing and proposal teams to develop competitive and compliant product offerings
- Validate product forecasts and monitor key customer budgets, market trends, and emerging requirements through independent research and customer engagement

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
- 7+ years of product management experience with demonstrated success in Federal Government, Civil agency, or defense/national security markets
- Demonstrated ability to develop and manage multi-year product roadmaps and drive portfolio offerings from concept through sustainment
- Experience with Stage-Gate, checkpoint review, or similar structured product development processes

Preferred Additional Skills:
- Proficiency with product lifecycle management tools (e.g., Jira, Aha!, Roadmunk, or equivalent)
- Demonstrated technical acumen with a working understanding of network architecture, information management, surveillance systems, and automation solutions
- Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities, drive end-to-end execution, and maintain budget accountability
- Proven ability to develop business cases, pricing strategies, and investment proposals for executive-level review
- Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts clearly to all levels of the organization
- Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments
- Proven ability to build and sustain effective working relationships with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization
- Demonstrated integrity and ability to foster open collaboration across Sales, Engineering, Program Management, and Marketing functions
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience with Agile or SAFe product development frameworks
- Demonstrated P&L ownership or revenue accountability for a product line or portfolio
- Experience leading portfolio-level strategic planning and investment prioritization activities
- Pragmatic Institute (PMMC) or Certified Product Manager (CPM) certification
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in Colorado State, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Vermont and New York State is $106,500- $197,000. For California, Seattle, Washington D.C., Maryland Greater Washington D.C. area, the city of Denver, Washington State and New York City, the salary range for this role is $122,000- $227,000. Job Description:

We are looking for a dynamic Product Management Professional to help drive the Devices Product Line through smart strategy, market insights, and successful product launches. This role works across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and commercial teams to bring innovative portable and mobile solutions to market while developing impactful sales tools and leading competitive analysis. Ideal candidates thrive in fast paced environments, take ownership of projects end to end, and are eager to make a meaningful impact.

Essential Functions:

- The Product Management Professional will provide a broad knowledge of product management support for the Devices Product Line Management team.
- Provide and deliver product reporting, participate in product line forecasting, conduct ongoing competitive and market analysis, and is closely involved with the vital initiatives to meet the product line revenue targets.
- Support robust and effective commercialization plans and the implementation of product activities for all new Portable and Mobile product launches to ensure attainment of financial objectives within launch timelines.
- Work across Product Line Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Configuration Management in preparation for introductions and productization in catalog.
- Communicates within and outside of own function or business area and has responsibility for communicating with parties external to the organization (e.g., customers, vendors, etc.) when necessary.
- Develop sales tools and collateral to equip field sales, inside sales and channel partners for success. Implement value-added selling promotions, training collateral, presentations, webinars, and other commercialization activities. Ensure all marketing and sales collateral reflects current product line with accurate data.
- Demonstrate strong initiative and ownership, proactively driving product activities and taking general oversight of key workstreams with minimal direction.
- Act as a self‑starter who anticipates needs, identifies gaps, and independently moves projects forward.
- Bring creative, outside‑the‑box thinking to solve complex problems, challenge assumptions, and identify innovative opportunities that strengthen the product line.
- Apply inventive approaches to product strategy, market analysis, and commercialization to improve outcomes and uncover new value.
- Conduct ongoing competitive and market analysis. Lead competitive benchmarking sessions, prepare competitive product feature comparison spreadsheets, prepare competitive pricing analysis and conduct ongoing market insight. Synthesize insight for input into product road maps, market positioning and strategic planning.
- Drive a culture of innovation by proactively identifying new solutions, tools, and approaches that enhance product performance, competitiveness, and internal processes.
- Prepare ad hoc reporting for product shipments, operational features, and historical sales trends.
- Provide training to sales, customer service and application engineers to enable stakeholders to successfully apply content and learnings into their respective disciplines.
- Participate in financial calls and inventory initiatives as requested. Help manage the reporting of product-line revenue and bookings to ensure accurate forecasting of product portfolio.
- Stay on top of industry trends and best practices across all areas of responsibility.
- Travel required (10%-25%).

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's with 6 years prior Product Manager / Product owner experience. Graduate Degree with 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Strong problem-solving, resource management, and time-management skills
- Broad knowledge of project management
- Ability to work independently on multiple projects at once with cross-functional teams
- Experience with LMR or LTE technology to support internal and external customers
- IP networking
- Sense of urgency to execute and success-oriented entrepreneurial attitude

The Lead, Product Manager, is responsible for managing the cost and schedule requirements of a product line offering through all phases from proposal to fulfillment. The product manager analyzes and designs technical product enhancements, integrating the work of research and development, manufacturing, marketing, sales, and service functions for all or part of a new or potential product offerings. This role drives product strategy, roadmap execution, investment prioritization and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery of scalable, mission-relevant capabilities to U.S. Government and international customers.
The Product Manager works closely with engineering, program management, operations, supply chain, finance, and business development to translate customer and market needs into executable product strategies while balancing cost, schedule performance and risk. This role will be based in Nashville, TN.

- Define and maintain product roadmaps and technical baselines, in partnership with engineering, including awareness of system architectures, key interfaces, and integration dependencies.
- Translate customer requirements, operational gaps, and market demand into clear product priorities and requirements.
- Serve as the product integrator and execution focal point across engineering, program management, operations, finance and business development, ensuring alignment of system architecture, interfaces and delivery commitments.
- Drive product-level decisions across cost, schedule, performance and risk, including architecture, interface and integration impacts.
- Develop product-level investment planning, including IRAD priorities, business cases and ROI justification.
- Support AOP, LRP, and budget planning by linking investments to roadmap outcomes and customer value.
- Interface across Product Line Management, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Configuration Management to ensure product requirements are executable and production-ready.
- Support capture and growth activities by providing product differentiation, technical positioning, and roadmap alignment.
- Communicates within and outside of own function or business area and has responsibility for communicating with parties external to the organization (e.g., customers, vendors, etc.) when necessary.
- Assess competitive offerings, emerging threats and technology trends relevant to ForceX missions.
- Establish and execute product governance, including milestone reviews and leadership decision forums.
- Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and global trade requirements.
- Work with a cross-functional team to ensure products meet profitability metrics. Offer solutions and develop plans to improve profitability.
- Business Travel up to 10% to L3Harris or customer sites.

- Bachelor's with 6 years prior Product Manager / Product owner experience. Graduate Degree with 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience managing complex DoW or national security systems that integrate hardware, software and external platforms across development, production and sustainment.
- Strong understanding of DoW acquisition environments, and compliance requirements associated with fielded defense systems.
- Experience managing complex hardware and software-based systems across development, integration, production and sustainment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience briefing senior leadership and customers.
- Experience supporting C-UAS, ISR, missile, C2, or mission systems.

Job Title: Scientist, Structural Engineering (Flight Sciences Technical Program Lead)
Job Code: 42351
Job Location: Greenville, TX/Rockwall, TX/Plano, TX (On-Site)
Job Schedule: 1st Shift 9/80

Job Description:
The Structural Engineering Scientist is responsible for technical solutions for the multi-discipline Flight Sciences team (aerodynamics, structural dynamics, structural analysis, durability and damage tolerance analysis, mass properties analysis) for special mission modifications to commercial aircraft. You will provide program-level guidance on showing compliance with FAA airworthiness regulations related to loads, structure, and weight & balance. You will work with program leadership and external engineering teams to coordinate the required engineering analysis and testing.

This position can sit in Greenville, TX, Rockwall, TX, or Plano, TX. This is a 100% onsite role.
Essential Functions:
- Support and review engineering bids and ROMs.
- Perform engineering work in one of the Flight Sciences disciplines up to their current job level to assist as needed.
- Lead Flight Sciences engineers to manage their scope, budget, and schedule performance.
- Mentor Flight Sciences engineers to develop their technical and leadership skills.
- Guide engineers in creating innovative solutions to complex engineering problems.
- Work with airworthiness authorities to optimize program certification approaches.
- Provide input on program plans and program schedules.
- Communication of programs flow down information to Flight Sciences.
- Review monthly labor forecasts and identify program staffing needs to ASE managers.
- Influence and collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders outside of Flight Sciences.
- Good computer skills including working knowledge of MS Office Suite.
- Willingness to travel up to 5%.
- Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.
- Other duties as assigned by Supervisor.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree with 15 years of experience in aerodynamics, structural dynamics, structural analysis, or durability and damage tolerance analysis in modifying fixed-wing manned aircraft.
- Graduate Degree with 13 years of experience in aerodynamics, structural dynamics, structural analysis, or durability and damage tolerance analysis in modifying fixed-wing manned aircraft.
- In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of experience in aerodynamics, structural dynamics, structural analysis, or durability and damage tolerance analysis in modifying fixed-wing manned aircraft.
- Minimum of five (5) years of experience leading a team of engineers.

Preferred Additional Skills:
- Active Secret Clearance.
- Experience with MSC Nastran, Femap, NX, and Teamcenter.
- Experience with Flight Testing.
